comments.content: `_print_info_once` and `_print_warning_once` are decorated with `@lru_cache`, which requires all arguments to be hashable. The new `*args: Hashable` annotation is only a type hint and does not enforce hashability at runtime. If a caller passes an unhashable argument (e.g., a list or dict), `lru_cache` will raise `TypeError: unhashable type`. Consider either removing `@lru_cache` and implementing deduplication differently, or ensuring callers only pass hashable arguments.
